subject: Initial MAP skeleton, evaluation timeline, and slide ownership
messages:
From: Claire Norton <claire@medsys.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP template & suggested evaluation timeline

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the performance numbers you showed on token latency are promising for our workflow. We had a quick internal sync and would like to start drafting a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to make the pilot concrete.

Could you share a MAP template (doc or slides) you typically use for pilots? We want something that captures:
- success metrics and acceptance criteria
- stakeholder owners and primary contacts
- week-by-week technical validation plan
- required artifacts (logs, SOC2 info, sample data)

Attached is a short requirements list from our infra team (MedSys_requirements.xlsx). Ideally we can agree on a 30–45 day pilot timeline with a clear acceptance gate.

Would you be able to share a starter doc today and propose a quick kick-off?

Thanks,
Claire Norton
Head of Product
MedSys.ai

--- Attachment: MedSys_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Norton <claire@medsys.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP template & suggested evaluation timeline

Claire —

Appreciate the clear ask and the attached requirements. I uploaded a lightweight MAP starter doc and a companion slide deck that we usually use to align stakeholders: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_map_template/edit (MAP starter) and https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1xYz_demo_slides_starter/edit (slides).

High-level proposed cadence (we can tweak):
- Week 0 (discovery, sample data exchange): 3–5 days
- Week 1 (integration + smoke tests): 7 days
- Week 2 (pilot validation + perf tuning): 7 days
- Week 3 (acceptance testing + stakeholder review): 7–10 days

Acceptance gate (proposal):
- Functional: model responses cover 95% of target intents in our evaluation set
- Performance: 99th percentile latency under agreed threshold for N concurrent users
- Ops: logs and retention validated; SOC2/contractual checklist items satisfied

Marissa, Jonas, Rishi — assigning owners in the doc would help speed this up. Can each of you pick a slide/section to own and add a 1–2 sentence plan in the doc by EOD?

Proposed owners (first pass):
- Marissa: pilot success criteria & stakeholder comms
- Jonas: technical acceptance tests and infra checklist
- Rishi: metrics, SLOs, and measurement plan

Next step: if Claire and team are OK with the cadence, propose a 30-minute kick-off tomorrow (Nov 16) at 9:30am PT or 1pm PT.

I also exported a quick PDF stub of the MAP with the above cadence for easy sharing — MAP_v1.pdf attached.

Best,
David Kim
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

--- Links: MAP starter doc, slides
--- Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (pdf, 18KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Norton <claire@medsys.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-16T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP template & suggested evaluation timeline

Thanks David / Claire — I reviewed the starter doc and added a short ‘pilot play’ section. Quick notes and owners added inline:

Marissa (me) — Demo plan, stakeholder comms cadence, customer success check-ins (week 1 & week 3)
Jonas — Technical acceptance tests: I added a table of test cases (smoke, perf, KV cache consistency) and flagged infra tickets MedSys needs to open
Rishi — Metrics & SLOs: rishi added token-level metrics and a sketch for alert thresholds; suggesting we tie an evaluation harness to the same prompt set Claire sent last week

Small asks from our side for the pilot to stay timeboxed:
- MedSys to provide a 50–200 example prompt set for functional validation by EOD Nov 17
- Access (read-only) to a staging cluster or a sanitized data sample for integration testing

I’m good to take ownership of the demo slides and a 5–7 minute walkthrough at the kick-off. I added slide owners in the deck.

If Claire confirms the 9:30am PT slot tomorrow, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short run-of-show.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior GTM Manager, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Norton <claire@medsys.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-16T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP template & suggested evaluation timeline

Claire — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming 9:30am PT tomorrow works for our team. I’m attaching the PDF stub (MAP_v1.pdf) again for your internal review.

To keep things lean, final checklist for the kickoff:
- MedSys provides sample prompts and any staging access (deadline: EOD Nov 17)
- Confirm point-of-contact for infra (email + Slack handle)
- Review MAP starter doc and accept/adjust owners in the doc before the call

Agenda (30 mins):
1) Introductions & goals (5 min)
2) Walkthrough of MAP + owners (10 min)
3) Integration requirements & acceptance tests (10 min)
4) Next steps & calendar (5 min)

If anyone on MedSys prefers the other slot (1pm PT), say now — otherwise I’ll send the 9:30 invite.

See you tomorrow,
David
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
